projection: simple cylindrical (plate carree), latitude +90 at the top

mercury_2k.webp.longitude: centre 0, east positive, -180 at the left edge
mercury_2k.webp.colour: three MDIS WAC filters as R, G, B (not named in the product label): enhanced, not natural; Mercury is a nearly neutral grey to the eye
mercury_2k.webp.filled: 4.1% of pixels had no data (gaps, the north polar cap) and were filled by a widening blur of their neighbours; colour fades to grey from 75 to 85 deg latitude (polar filter noise); north of 82 deg N is a flat zonal fill
mercury_2k.webp.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Carnegie Institution of Washington; USGS Astrogeology

mars_2k.webp.longitude: centre 0, east positive, -180 at the left edge

jupiter_2k.webp.longitude: full 360 deg, planetocentric latitude; orientation not stated in the caption
jupiter_2k.webp.source: PIA07782, Cassini's Best Maps of Jupiter (cylindrical), 3601 x 1801, December 2000
jupiter_2k.webp.note: the polar regions beyond ~60 deg were not imaged and are a flat fill in the original

saturn_2k.webp.longitude: System III west longitude, 360 at the left edge decreasing to 0 at the right
saturn_2k.webp.latitude: planetographic, -90..90 at 5 px a degree (native size, not enlarged to 2048)
saturn_2k.webp.filled: rows OPAL did not see (ring band, polar caps) interpolated per column
saturn_2k.webp.colour: F631N, F502N, F395N as R, G, B with OPAL's slight contrast enhancement
saturn_2k.webp.credit: NASA, ESA, A. Simon (GSFC) and the OPAL team. This work used data acquired from the NASA/ESA HST Space Telescope, associated with OPAL program (PI: Simon, GO13937), and archived by the Space Telescope Science Institute (doi:10.17909/T9G593).

saturn_rings_tau.bin.type: f32 little endian, normal optical depth tau (>= 0)
saturn_rings_tau.bin.saturated: 155 samples where the star vanished (dense B ring) carry their lower limit, at least 2.5 (5 where even that is unknown)
saturn_rings_tau.bin.use: transmission along a ray = exp(-tau / |cos(incidence)|); opacity seen face on = 1 - exp(-tau)
saturn_rings_tau.bin.colour: none: no public-domain radial colour profile was assembled (see SOURCES.md)
saturn_rings_tau.bin.source: Voyager 2 PPS delta Sco occultation, 1981-08-26, PDS VG_2801 EASYDATA/KM010/PS1P01.TAB
saturn_rings_tau.bin.credit: NASA/JPL Voyager PPS team (Esposito, Lane et al.); PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node
